headline: Apple's next smart home hub reportedly named HomeView, Bloomberg says
summary: Apple's upcoming smart home hub will reportedly be named 'HomeView,' according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, with the announcement expected Tuesday. Bloomberg also reports the device will begin shipping in November.

claims.statement: Apple's upcoming smart home hub will reportedly be named 'HomeView' and announced Tuesday, per Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

sources.quote: Apple's smart home hub will reportedly be called HomeView
Apple will announce a new smart home hub on Tuesday called the HomeView, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman.

claims.statement: Bloomberg reports the HomeView device will begin shipping in November.
